name: convert_file
description: Convert media files between formats using local tools. Supports: IMAGE formats (jpg, png, webp, gif, tiff, bmp), RASTER to VECTOR (jpg/png → svg via Potrace), VIDEO formats (mp4, webm, mov, avi, mkv), AUDIO formats (mp3, wav, flac, ogg, aac), and VIDEO to AUDIO extraction. Input can be a stash reference (stash://space_xxx/file_id) or file path. Output is saved to stash for download. Example: convert my uploaded image to SVG, convert video to mp3.

source.description: Source file: stash://space_id/file_id reference OR local file path

target_format.description: Target format extension without dot: png, jpg, webp, gif, svg, mp4, webm, mp3, wav, flac, ogg, aac

options.description: Optional conversion settings. Image: quality (1-100), resize ('800x600' or '50%'), strip_metadata (bool). Video: crf (quality 0-51), resolution ('1920x1080'), fps, duration (seconds). Audio: bitrate ('192k'), sample_rate (44100), channels (1 or 2). SVG: threshold ('50%' for tracing)
